verdict.rationale: The only OpenAI-compatible endpoint in the evidence is the hosted Wally Cloud API (docs-4, under wally-cloud/api.md), which is a different capability from a local server. The local-run evidence says the CLI can run small models offline and point tools at a model, but it never documents launching a local OpenAI-compatible HTTP server for loaded models. A local serving API is a fair axis for an on-device inference product, so this is "none", not "na".
